MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits my small electronics projects because it would help insulate exposed connections and keep wiring organized after using boards, jumper wires, and relays.",
    "The digital caliper feels useful for checking component dimensions and mounting clearances. The solder seal connectors also make sense for permanent wiring, provided they fit the wire sizes I use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The three PLA filament choices assume I have a compatible 3D printer, but my electronics purchases do not establish that need.",
    "The large battery lugs are intended for much heavier wiring than my small circuit projects. The feeler gauge and thick acrylic sheet would need specific projects I have not shown a need for.",
    "The caster wheels match a recent purchase, but I already selected a set and have no clear reason to buy another."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in fabrication and 3D printing supplies.",
    "Electrical supplies seem to be treated as interchangeable even though wire size and connection type determine whether I can use them.",
    "A recent caster purchase seems to have been taken as a reason to recommend another similar set."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, PCB supplies, and relay point toward small component work, where suitable dimensions and wiring compatibility matter.",
    "I need a practical use for an item now: tubing helps finish wiring, while filament requires equipment I have not shown that I own.",
    "A durable item I recently selected may already meet my need, even when another version looks relevant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my DIY electronics interests but stretched them into unsupported equipment needs and repeat purchases."
}
